2607.04832.title: Semantic Homogenization in Italian Popular Music: A Diachronic Analysis
2607.04832.paper_summary: In recent years, studies have revealed a decline in semantic variety across popular music lyrics, particularly in English-language songs on streaming platforms like Spotify. This research examines whether a similar trend can be observed in a different linguistic and cultural context: the lyrics of all finalist songs from the 75 editions of the Sanremo Music Festival, Italy's most renowned music competition. What sets this work apart is the development of a flexible and efficient methodology for tracking changes in semantic similarity over time, which can be applied to different datasets to study similar phenomena. Drawing on a combination of full-text, segment-based, topic-based, and word-level analyses, the approach leverages both embedding techniques and large language models. When applied to the Sanremo corpus, this framework reveals a gradual move toward increasing semantic uniformity, echoing the global patterns identified in previous studies. These findings underscore the value of natural language processing tools in uncovering long-term shifts in musical language and cultural expression.
2607.04832.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，研究顯示流行音樂歌詞的語義多樣性有所下降，特別是在像Spotify這樣的串流平台上的英語歌曲中。這項研究考察了在不同語言和文化背景下是否可以觀察到類似的趨勢：即意大利最著名的音樂競賽——聖雷莫音樂節75屆所有入圍歌曲的歌詞。這項工作的特點在於開發了一種靈活且高效的方法來追踪語義相似性的變化，該方法可以應用於不同的數據集來研究類似的現象。這種方法結合了全文、基於段落、基於主題和基於詞彙的分析，利用了嵌入技術和大型語言模型。當應用於聖雷莫語料庫時，這一框架顯示出語義一致性逐漸增加的趨勢，呼應了以往研究中識別的全球模式。這些發現凸顯了自然語言處理工具在揭示音樂語言和文化表達的長期變化中的價值。
